classSteps: Choose your class times online, selecting the relevant practitioner
Class full? Get in touch to join the waitlist

paragraphs: Given there is a waitlist for many classes, please provide as much notice as possible if you need to cancel or reschedule your booking so the time can be offered to another client.
Please give at least 8 hours’ notice if you need to cancel. Bookings cancelled with less than 8 hours’ notice are charged the full price.

classFacts.value: Exercise sessions may be claimable, depending on your level of cover

studioEtiquette.name: Grip socks, please
studioEtiquette.detail: Grip socks are preferred on the equipment for hygiene and to help it last. They’re available to buy in the clinic, or bring your hospital or trampoline socks.

studioEtiquette.name: No sneakers on the equipment
studioEtiquette.detail: Preferably no sneakers on the equipment. There’s a shoe rack outside to keep the dirt out.

studioEtiquette.name: Wearing orthotics?
studioEtiquette.detail: Sneakers are fine. Just let us know so we can adjust the setup for you.

booking.classes: Check availability and book classes in the online booking portal. When booking, select the relevant practitioner. If your preferred class time isn’t showing, it’s at full capacity, but please get in touch if you’d like to be added to the waitlist.
booking.bookingCode: Want to save time and avoid creating a new profile every time you book? Ask Nicole or Laura for your unique online booking code, or for access to the patient portal.
booking.waitlistText: To join the cancellation waitlist, text us on
